nodes.description: Owner address state variable in Ownable; set to msg.sender at construction and updated in transferOwnership.
ERC20BasicInterface token instance held by BatchTransferWallet; target of external transfer/balanceOf calls.
Public decimals value of ERC20BasicInterface, read externally to compute token scaling.
Ownable constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender; initial access-control principal assignment.
onlyOwner function reassigning ownership to newOwner; guarded privileged state write.
SafeMath multiplication with assert-based overflow check.
SafeMath addition with assert-based overflow check.
SafeMath subtraction with assert-based underflow check.
SafeMath integer division.
Constructor of BatchTransferWallet casting _tokenAddress into the token state variable.
onlyOwner loop transferring scaled token amounts to many investors via external token.transfer calls.
onlyOwner function draining the contract token balance to a chosen address via external token.transfer.
View function returning the token balance held by this contract.
External interface call token.balanceOf used to read balances.
External interface call token.transfer that moves tokens out of the contract.
msg.sender; untrusted caller used for ownership assignment and onlyOwner authorization checks.
External call token.transfer(_investors[i], _tokenAmounts[i]) inside the batchTransfer loop; transfer of control to an untrusted token contract.
External call token.transfer(_address, tokenBalanceOfContract) in withdraw; state is not updated before the external call.
Arithmetic scaling in batchTransfer: 10 ** uint256(token.decimals()) exponentiation and _tokenAmounts[i].mul(decimalsForCalc) multiplication.
External call token.decimals() whose return value drives the scaling factor decimalsForCalc.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership; new owner address written into owner.
First uint256 operand a of SafeMath.mul.
Second uint256 operand b of SafeMath.mul.
Constructor parameter _tokenAddress used to initialize the token state variable.
Parameter _investors, array of recipient addresses in batchTransfer.
Parameter _tokenAmounts, array of token amounts mutated and transferred in batchTransfer.
Parameter _address, withdrawal receiver in withdraw.
Local decimalsForCalc holding 10 ** token.decimals() scaling factor.
Loop index i iterating over the investor arrays in batchTransfer.
Local tokenBalanceOfContract caching token.balanceOf(this) in withdraw.
Return local c capturing a * b in SafeMath.mul.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned as owner in the Ownable constructor, establishing the privileged principal.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferOwnership.
msg.sender is checked against owner by onlyOwner before batchTransfer executes.
msg.sender is checked against owner by onlyOwner before withdraw executes.
newOwner is written into the owner state variable, transferring privileged control.
newOwner is the input parameter consumed by transferOwnership.
_tokenAddress is cast and stored into the token state variable during construction.
_tokenAddress is the constructor parameter of BatchTransferWallet.
_investors array is consumed by the batchTransfer loop.
_tokenAmounts array is consumed and mutated by the batchTransfer loop.
Each _tokenAmounts[i] element is multiplied by decimalsForCalc, feeding the arithmetic scaling operation.
decimalsForCalc supplies the multiplier for _tokenAmounts[i].mul(decimalsForCalc).
decimalsForCalc is the locally computed scaling factor used throughout batchTransfer.
Loop index i drives the for-loop control flow in batchTransfer.
batchTransfer invokes the external token.transfer call inside its loop, handing control to an untrusted contract.
The token state variable is the target of the external transfer call in batchTransfer.
batchTransfer performs the scaling multiplication/exponentiation arithmetic.
The token state variable is the target of the external transfer call in withdraw.
withdraw makes an external token.transfer call before finishing execution.
_address is the receiver parameter of withdraw.
_address is passed as the recipient argument of the external token.transfer call in withdraw.
tokenBalanceOfContract is the locally cached balance used by withdraw.
tokenBalanceOfContract is passed as the amount argument to the external token.transfer call.
token is the contract instance on which balanceOf is called.
balanceOfContract performs the external token.balanceOf(this) call.
withdraw performs the external token.balanceOf(this) call to size the balance.
The decimals state variable is read through the external token.decimals() call.
The result of token.decimals() determines the decimalsForCalc local value.
SafeMath.mul stores the product in the return local c.
transferOwnership, once authorized by onlyOwner, rewrites the owner state variable.
The BatchTransferWallet constructor writes the token state variable.
The Ownable constructor writes the privileged owner state variable.
SafeMath.mul implements the checked arithmetic backing the scaling operation.
_investors[i] supplies the recipient argument of the external token.transfer call in batchTransfer.
_tokenAmounts[i] supplies the scaled amount argument of the external token.transfer call in batchTransfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newOwner only exists to feed the owner write inside transferOwnership.
Operand a is a transient parameter of SafeMath.mul's overflow-checked multiplication.
Operand b is a transient parameter of SafeMath.mul's overflow-checked multiplication.
_tokenAddress is only consumed by the constructor assignment to token.
_investors is only consumed by the batchTransfer loop and its transfer calls.
_tokenAmounts is only consumed and scaled within batchTransfer.
_address is only consumed by withdraw as the transfer recipient.
decimalsForCalc is a temporary scaling factor local to batchTransfer.
Loop index i is a transient counter belonging to batchTransfer.
tokenBalanceOfContract is a temporary cached balance used only by withdraw.
Product local c is the transient return value of SafeMath.mul.
